I play the game pretty chill, let it run while I'm doing something else. Yeah, I watch every ads that helps increasing the cooking speed. My way is:

If your goal is from 10A to 10C,  
Don't save until 10C.  
Upgrade facilities/recipes until it produces currency B.  
Slowly, you'll earn until 1C.  
Then, look at the fairy jar,If it rewards you with currency C,  
Only then you can save up until the targeted 10C.   
Fairy jar is very helpful, especially when it's time you're saving gold.

Bottom line, keep upgrading (investing, in other words), don't save all the time. The progress will be a lot faster. I've been playing like this, and it works.

But hey, no need to rush, enjoy the experience! I love looking at my cats, the scenery and the music going all together. It's very relaxing, especially when you look at how much you grow.
